name: Zenbook Duo Snap
description: Window snapping and touch helpers for the ASUS Zenbook Duo: while a window is dragged, a popup snaps it to either screen, across both, or to an external screen; F8 / Shift+F8 swap windows between the screens; F7 opens display controls (what is shown, positions, mirroring, table mode, scale, rotation and brightness); the on-screen keyboard opens on the screen without the text field and stays off while the keyboard is attached; pop-ups for the Duo keys (with the Zenbook Duo services).
